name: Band Dead Bug
description: Lying on your back with a band looped round both feet, knees bent over your hips and arms up, straighten one leg and reach the opposite arm overhead against the band, then return and switch.

source.title: Physitrack: Resisted dead bugs
source.note: Described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Lie on your back, a small band looped round both feet.
Knees bent over your hips, arms straight up.
cues: Low back stays on the floor.
The other leg holds still against the band.

prescription.note: Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower, resting between exercises as needed.

keyframes.name: Arms up, knees up
keyframes.cue: Knees over hips, arms to the ceiling.

keyframes.name: Extend
keyframes.cue: Lower your right arm overhead and straighten your left leg.
